title: First-mile VPC onboarding map + credential rotation slate
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, narrative-first visual slate that guides operators through the 'first-mile' of Private/VPC onboarding with a special emphasis on credential provisioning and automated rotation. This ticket covers: 1) a step-by-step onboarding map that lives in the Console and docs (desktop + mobile variants); 2) three annotated product screenshots for the installer flow (network checks, bootstrap key exchange, health checks); 3) a credential rotation explainer card and a micro-UI showing rotating API keys/KMS handshake; 4) two small animations (healthy handshake + failed upgrade rollback) for the quickstart; 5) CLI quickstart card with inline verification commands. Target audiences: platform engineers doing initial install, SREs validating upgrades, and solutions engineers creating customer-facing runbooks. Deliverables must be exported for docs (PNG, SVG) and for the Console UI team (Figma slices and an HTML prototype). Emphasis: clarity around automated rotation, where the secrets live, and clear failure-state remediation steps so customers can see the signal early.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding map SVG exported in desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x812) sizes and annotated for dev handoff
Three annotated product screenshots (network check, bootstrap handshake, health summary) included with dev notes and copy text
Credential rotation card with step labels and KMS flow diagram approved by Security
Two short animations (max 6s) showing handshake success and upgrade rollback, delivered as MP4 + Lottie
CLI quickstart card with 3 verification commands and copy reviewed by Docs
Design tokens and spacing documented in the handoff file; Figma link added to ticket
tasks: Draft onboarding narrative and initial wireframes
Iterate visuals based on infra review (handshake sequencing)
Export assets, create handoff package, and add to Confluence
Follow-up: onboard Console devs during integration sprint
